title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Default Reporting, Foreclosure Timing and Liquidation Terms
content:
For loans backed by the VA Home Loan Guaranty, each program fixes four servicing figures: the calendar days a payment must be past due before the servicer reports the loan in default; the calendar days of delinquency before a servicer may make the first foreclosure filing; the most relocation assistance paid to a borrower completing a compromise sale or deed in lieu; and whether a guaranty claim paid on a liquidated loan creates a Home Loan Guaranty Debt for the veteran.

## Figures by program

| Program | Days past due before default is reported | Days of delinquency before the first foreclosure filing | Most relocation assistance (USD) | Guaranty claim on a liquidated loan creates a Home Loan Guaranty Debt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | 61 | 120 | 1500.00 | Yes |

## Timing illustrated (hypothetical payment)

| Days the hypothetical payment is past due | Reported in default at 61 days | First foreclosure filing permitted at 120 days of delinquency |
|---|---|---|
| 60 | not yet | no |
| 61 | yes | no |
| 119 | yes | no |
| 120 | yes | yes |

Both counts are in calendar days. The relocation assistance figure is a maximum; a borrower may receive up to 1500.00 dollars.
